premises.text: Packing and shipping cost for diverse real retail items is hard to determine; carrier quotes require boxes/crates/pallets and the market is fragmented across parcel, freight, courier, and more
premises.evidence_span: it's so hard to determine what it costs to pack and ship something

premises.text: ShipHawk aggregates fragmented shipping markets so shippers can move almost any item size/weight to almost any destination from one site
premises.evidence_span: we have aggregated all of these different markets into one website

premises.text: The system converts real items into packed weights and dimensions to give instant packing and multi-carrier shipping quotes with service options
premises.evidence_span: we're going to convert your real item into packed weights and dimensions

premises.text: Users can schedule pickup, drop at ShipHawk network locations, or get local delivery facilitated by the same agent network, then pay and print labels
premises.evidence_span: you get to schedule a pickup at your home or office. Or you can find a local ShipHawk network location

premises.text: Revenue is commissions from shipping, packing, insurance, and other service providers sent business
premises.evidence_span: ShipHawk makes money by collecting a commission from all the service providers that we send business to

value.text: Make packing and shipping easy, fast, and transparent for retail shippers of diverse real items
value.evidence_span: help us make shipping easy for everyone

causal_links.evidence_span: instant packing quotes, instant shipping quotes
collecting a commission from all the service providers that we send business to

notes: Fragmented carrier types and quote frictions folded into one problem premise (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). Kayak analogy treated as framing, not a premise. Founder experience excluded as team narrative rather than a market condition.
